title: Special Topics in History; From Blood Libel to QAnon: 900 Years of Anti-Jewish "Conspiracy Theories"
description: Traces the historical predecessors of contemporary anti-Jewish conspiracy theories from their pre-modern origins, through the rise of racial anti-Semitism and its role in Nazi ideology, into the 21st century. Investigates the motivations and appeal of conspiracy theories to their believers and explores the unique link between anti-Semitism and conspiracy theories.
